rows.definition: internal/benchmarkdown RenderAdapterReport renders the shared headings, metadata order, summary table, task table, promotion section, and spacing for an already-projected benchmark adapter report.
rows.distinction: Owns only the cross-benchmark adapter-report LAYOUT after callers preformat domain rows - NOT the package-specific RenderMarkdown functions that project measured domain reports, and NOT pre-run contract renderers.

rows.definition: NativeInferenceReceipt.RenderedSHA256 carries the lowercase SHA-256 digest of the exact rendered prompt bytes that were tokenized for an opt-in native inference receipt.
rows.distinction: Identifies rendered prompt bytes; it is not the generated-token list, prompt-token list, tokenizer identity, or renderer identity.

rows.definition: NativeInferenceReceipt.RendererID identifies the prompt template and thinking-policy variant that produced the rendered bytes recorded by an opt-in native inference receipt.
rows.distinction: Identifies the prompt renderer contract; it is not the tokenizer, model, backend, or a scorecard Markdown projector.

rows.definition: agent.inKernelPromptRendererID selects the stable renderer identity from model configuration and sampling options for native prompt encoding and receipts.
rows.distinction: Selects an identity string only; it does not render prompt bytes, tokenize them, or execute inference.
